signal_data_card.costs: No sourced trading-cost input exists; the net-of-cost objective is unscorable.
signal_data_card.formula: (latest usable BAA yield - earliest usable BAA yield) × 100 basis points
signal_data_card.lookahead_survivorship_risks: Current FRED history may contain later observations or revisions; retrieve ALFRED at each future decision date. This macro series does not establish a survivorship-free security universe.
signal_data_card.missing_data_rule: Stop if fewer than two usable observations exist, a date/value is invalid, a yield is nonpositive, or availability precedes observation date.
signal_data_card.provider: FRED series BAA; source shown by FRED is Moody's. Historical information set: ALFRED vintage rule.
signal_data_card.rebalance_timing: Annual mandate rebalancing. The stored initial decision is 2026-10-02, the next decision day after the documented 2026-10-01 September release.
signal_data_card.transformations: No imputation or forward fill. Values remain percentage points until the basis-point subtraction.
signal_data_card.universe: The eight Lab 13 holdings. The signal selects between existing Candidates A and D; it does not create securities.

source_facts.signal_source: course BAA data card and documented observations
